purpose: Record the source-image page roles of the governed Changamwe Form 34B sample so constituency totals are extracted from the final TOTAL row rather than inferred from a partial polling-station page.

page_roles.treatment: Polling-station rows are source context and reconciliation evidence only. Any page-level sum is a partial subtotal and must not be treated as a constituency result.

The final TOTAL row is the preferred direct source location for registered voters, total valid votes and rejected ballots for the governed sample. Candidate extraction must remain machine_candidate until each field is independently source-image verified.
Administrative/signature evidence only; do not search this page for constituency turnout integers.

extraction_route.reason: The official source image exposes a final TOTAL row containing the governed target fields. Direct source-row extraction is less error-prone than summing OCR transcriptions from partial table pages.

governance.next_gate: Create a deterministic page-2 TOTAL-row machine-candidate extractor and reconcile its registered-voter candidate to the existing governed constituency denominator. Independently source-image verify all three fields before any sample row can become verified.
